title: Add SSO connection: before the test sign-in
summary: The Test sign-in step as the operator first meets it: one primary 'Sign in with Kestrel Labs' that opens the provider in a new window, the fallback when a browser blocks the window, an empty claims area ('Nothing sent yet'), and 'Continue to domains' disabled until one sign-in has worked.
compare: Same wizard as identity.connection-new (ST-39 kit, Test sign-in current); the lead paragraph is identical.

One primary in the body, 'Sign in with Kestrel Labs'; it opens Kestrel Labs’ sign-in in a new window. While the window is open the button reads 'Waiting for Kestrel Labs…' with a spinner, and focus returns to the step when it closes.
If the browser blocks the window, the step says so in place of the info line and offers 'Open the sign-in in this tab', a same-tab redirect that comes back to this step (state kept server-side).
The claims area is an empty state, 'Nothing sent yet'. No select is shown before there is anything to pick from.
Foot: Cancel (ghost, left), Back, the hint 'Sign in once to continue' and 'Continue to domains' disabled. Success is identity.connection-new; a refusal is identity.connection-new-failed.
Phone: the sign-in panel stacks (text, then the button full width), the hint sits above the foot buttons, and the primary keeps its own row.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink and selection is ink, the accent marks context only; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

findings.issue: Phone footer on three left edges; stepper label collided with its connector.
findings.resolution: Step line plus progress bar; footer column with the disabled reason above the buttons (.foot-reason).

findings.issue: Wizard left-pinned; the empty 'Nothing sent yet' panel was mostly padding.
findings.resolution: Centred 960px column; empty state is a 120px strip with the icon inline; the disabled-Continue reason moved to the left footer slot.

findings.issue: The same fact three times (prompt, 'Window blocked?' link, secondary line); card sparse.
findings.resolution: One card row: prompt, the 12px 'Window blocked? Open in this tab' link beside the button; empty-state second sentence cut.

findings.issue: Right rail with 'What you'll have at the end' and a waiting/timeout state.
findings.resolution: declined: adds content and states; centring solves the dead space; the waiting state is a flow question for the program.
